figures.alt: Illustration of a boy in a yellow raincoat and rain boots with an umbrella, walking past a puddle on a rainy street.
figures.caption: We pick rain gear because of what it does: it keeps water out.

figures.alt: Photo of ice cubes melting in a glass bowl with a puddle of water, and a pat of butter softening in a pan.
figures.caption: Warming melts ice and softens butter. Both are physical changes, and cooling can change them back.

figures.alt: Interactive: five numbered blocks are rearranged into different shapes while the count stays five.
figures.caption: Build five blocks into a tower, a house, a train, or a plus sign.
